title: Stand-mode console layout (iPhone Duo, optional)
summary: Owner-selected Duo feature (candidate 1). Folded at about 90 degrees, the upper display half is 100 % photograph with no HUD overlay at all; the lower half holds the floating stick, jump, the contextual action, the diorama minimap with summit beacon, route lines, and vista markers, and the timer. Reads like a handheld console. Additive: non-foldable iPhones keep the standard two-thumb layout.
scope_out: Split View ghost races (candidate 5, not selected)

acceptance_tests.test: gj-design's mockup of the console layout is reviewed against DESIGN_SYSTEM §5 (Duo variant clause) and Design Skills rules 1, 18, and 21 before implementation starts.
acceptance_tests.evidence: mockup in design/proposals/mockups/duo-stand/ and the review comment

acceptance_tests.test: When the device reports the stand posture, the play view moves to the upper half with no HUD overlay; the lower half holds stick, jump, contextual action, minimap, and timer; controls at least 56 pt; layout built from design/tokens.
acceptance_tests.evidence: clip or screenshots when a device or simulator is available; otherwise a design walkthrough in the PR

acceptance_tests.test: Leaving the stand posture returns to the standard layout within one frame with an inertialized camera; no gameplay state is lost.
On non-foldable iPhones nothing changes (an EditMode test asserting the layout selector defaults to standard is suggested).
Frame time in stand mode stays within the SPEC §6 targets on a Duo.

history.event: created by the Coordinator (Owner selection of iPhone Duo candidates 1–3 and App Store Connect key confirmation, AUTH #003)

notes: Go/no-go at the M3 checkpoint; unfinished work ships in v1.1.
